about_the_game:
🟥 About This Game
There’s a girl at the ramen shop.
She looks up when you sit beside her, curious, kind, maybe a little distant.
You talk. You connect.
Then the next night, she doesn’t recognize you at all.

Welcome to It's You Again | また、きみだ。
A romance comedy (but ofc wholesome) about remembering someone who forgets.

You’re not here to fix her.
You’re here to find out if this feeling is real.

Will you try again?
Will she fall for you?
Or will you walk away?

This game is based on a post from the Akabako Community Message Board.
Username: soupagain.
Title: “She never remembers. But I can’t forget her.”

More soon.

Kōbako

🟥 Gameplay Features

Talk to Her
You meet her at the ramen shop. She doesn’t remember.
You decide what kind of stranger you’ll be tonight.

Narrator Conflict
There’s a voice in your head.
It remembers everything.
You can listen to it… or fight back.

Multiple Outcomes
You can try to win her heart 🌹
Or you can let her go💔

8 Possible Versions of Her
If you ever decide to start over, really start over, you might meet someone a little different.
There are 8 possible versions of her, each with their own way of speaking, feeling, and connecting; The Child-Loving Illustrator. The Hopeless Romantic Kindergarten Teacher. The Free Spirited Model. The Sweet Baker. The Awkward Screenwriter. The Dreamy Ex-Figure Skater.... and more!
She always forgets.
But maybe that’s the point.

🟥 Universe Note
Part of the Kōbako Games
Short games. Long shadows.
Each Kōbako title is based on a thread from the Akabako Community Message Board: weird stories, ghost sightings, strangers, rumors, unfinished conversations.

Some usernames repeat. Some stories connect.

The more you play, the more Akabako remembers you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: A romantic loop 3D visual novel about a girl who forgets you every night. It’s always your first date. She resets. You don’t. Try to win her heart, or choose to let go. Another strange post from the town of Akabako.
